text.text_excerpt: Love me some Nola Nica! Yesterday, I was craving something new for lunch. Being it was National Burger Day (and I love a good burger) I decided I would opt for a twist on this all-American classic. I found NolaNica on the Ritual food ordering app (as you can see in my previous reviews, this is definitely a favorite) and immediately ordered the NolaNica Burger. I was a bit skeptical since I had never tried Nicaraguan food before and the photos I saw online of the burger didn't do it much justice, but I figured why not! The NolaNica Burger consists of a beef patty dressed with fried cheese, sweet plantains, vinaigrette slaw, topped with Nola Nica sauce on toasted coconut bread. When I say t...

Wow! WHAT A BURGER. Sorry to the original users of that slogan but it is so fitting. I ran by the UPS store in St. Charles Place and decided to hit the food court because I always seem to forget its there. So after reading a few other places' menus, I stumbled upon Nola Nica & saw the words "gallo pinto" and knew this was the place for me. I visited Nicaragua and Costa Rica last year and fell in love with Latin American cuisine so I was glad to find this place. I was craving a burger though so I went for their Nola Nica burger. YUUUUUUM. I was running an errand around St Charles Ave and stopped by the food court inside Place St Charles. I had no clue that they revamped the entire food court area recently. I remember coming here back in the day and they really did not offer very exciting options. But that has completely changed! One of the new vendors I saw that sounded intriguing was Nolanica. I actually ran into my Nicaraguan friend at the food court and she told me Nolanica is very authentic so I had to check them out myself and it did not disappoint me at all!
